Bright hello weekend team,
The shift coordinator sent an update on water bowls.

Please keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk notes current for every booking, from first contact through arrival pickup. We are the steady point of contact for families, and our guidance should make each step easier to follow. When a case needs review, move it through the usual calm chain and keep the customer informed in clear, respectful language. <<FACT F107>> Make sure the handoff records are complete before you close the file, and confirm that any pet care notes are easy to locate for the next colleague.

For boarding cases, please review each checklist carefully and support travelers with practical, reassuring guidance. <<FACT F093>> If any detail is missing, resolve it before the booking is considered ready, and document the follow-up in plain language. We should continue to treat each journey as a shared responsibility, especially when a pet has specific care needs or when the customer is anxious about the process. Our tone should remain formal, patient, and focused on the customer's comfort, because that is how we protect trust in Aurelia Skyways and keep service consistent across the weekend.

Please stay attentive to water bowl placement, carrier notes, and pickup instructions, and share any concern promptly with the senior coordinator so it can be reviewed without delay. Companion Animal Travel Desk
